verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a managed search/RAG platform like Orama Cloud, but the evidence pack never documents issuing scoped, read-only, or least-privilege keys for an agent. The Secure Proxy, which hides the OpenAI key on the client, and the per-project MCP server are related features, not credential scoping. The REST APIs are also described as private, with no published reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
